description: This Java class `NoopCborFactory` is a no-operation implementation of the `CborFactory` interface. It provides methods related to CBOR serialization/deserialization, but all methods throw UnsupportedOperationException except for isCborAvailable(), which returns false. It essentially acts as a stub or placeholder within the project.

classes.name: NoopCborFactory
classes.description: A no-operation implementation of the CborFactory interface that throws UnsupportedOperationException for all serialization/deserialization methods and indicates CBOR is not available.

methods.name: isCborAvailable
methods.description: Returns false indicating CBOR capabilities are not available in this implementation.
